sap.app.title: Overflow Toolbar - layout
sap.app.description: Ten OverflowToolbars demonstrating OverflowToolbarLayoutData priorities: NeverOverflow, AlwaysOverflow, High, Low, Disappear and grouped overflow via the group property. Also shows SegmentedButton-to-Select conversion in overflow, shrinkable items with minWidth, and label-select pairing. Includes a keyboard command shortcut (Ctrl+E Share).
